decisions.reason: The source defines the roles of the main and sensor boards but does not change the power board's mechanical form factor.
Describing the other two boards as simpler does not change the power board's four-layer stack or grounding strategy.
The sensor-board connector-hub role is already fully represented by the candidate's INTRODUCE Event from the same source message.
The board-role clarification does not alter the interboard power connector type, pin count, or matching rule.
Calling the main board a standard ESP32-S3 board does not necessarily change its specified charge-status indication path.
The source does not discuss or change the power-board battery connector interface.
The main and sensor board role descriptions do not change the established I2C speed, pull-ups, cabling, or resistor policy.
The mention of standard ESP32-S3 architecture does not modify the production component sourceability policy.
The source does not change the selected interboard signal connector or its pinout.
A sensor board consisting primarily of connectors does not necessarily alter the separately specified switched 5V sensor-power rail.
The roles assigned to the main and sensor boards do not change the power-board battery protection requirements.
The source does not change the deferred requirement for assembly-ready BOM part numbers on the power board.
